question: How many customers are there in total?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

question: How many products are in the Books category?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE category = 'Books'

question: List all distinct product categories.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT category FROM products

question: How many orders have the status cancelled?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

question: What is the name and price of the most expensive product?
gold_sql: SELECT product_name, unit_price FROM products ORDER BY unit_price DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many customers live in Mumbai?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE city = 'Mumbai'

question: How many orders were placed in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2025

question: How many orders were paid using UPI?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE payment_method = 'UPI'

question: What is the average product price? Round to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(unit_price), 2) FROM products

question: How many customers signed up in 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM signup_date) = 2026

question: How many orders are there for each status? Show status and count.
gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status

question: How many customers are there in each state? Show state and count.
gold_sql: SELECT state, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY state

question: What is the total revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'

question: What is the total revenue for each product category? Show category and revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.category

question: What are the top 5 products by total quantity sold? Show product name and total quantity.
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_qty FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY total_qty DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which city has the most customers? Show the city and the number of customers.
gold_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average order value? Round to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(order_total), 2) FROM (SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS order_total FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.order_id) t

question: How many orders were placed in each month of 2025? Show the month number and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) AS month, COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2025 GROUP BY 1

question: How many orders were placed with each payment method? Show payment method and count.
gold_sql: SELECT payment_method, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY payment_method

question: How many customers have never placed an order?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL

question: How many different customers placed at least one order in 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2026

question: What is the average product price in each category? Show category and the average rounded to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT category, ROUND(AVG(unit_price), 2) FROM products GROUP BY category

question: What is the total revenue from the Electronics category?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND p.category = 'Electronics'

question: Which 3 states have the highest number of orders? Show state and order count.
gold_sql: SELECT c.state, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.state ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 3

question: How many orders contain more than 2 different products?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT order_id FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) > 2) t

question: Who are the top 5 customers by total spend? Show full name and total spend.
gold_sql: SELECT c.full_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_spend FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name ORDER BY total_spend DESC LIMIT 5

question: For each category, which product sold the highest total quantity? Show category and product name.
gold_sql: SELECT category, product_name FROM (SELECT p.category, p.product_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC) AS rnk FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.category, p.product_name) t WHERE rnk = 1

question: What is the revenue for each month of 2026? Show the month number and revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) AS month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2026 GROUP BY 1

question: How many customers placed more than 8 orders?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 8) t

question: Which payment method has the highest average order value? Show the payment method and the average rounded to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT payment_method, ROUND(AVG(order_total), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT o.order_id, o.payment_method, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS order_total FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.order_id, o.payment_method) t GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC LIMIT 1

question: What percentage of all orders were returned? Round to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'returned') / COUNT(*), 2) FROM orders

question: For each product in the Sports category, what is the total quantity sold? Show product name and quantity, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS qty FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND p.category = 'Sports' GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY qty DESC

question: How many customers placed orders in both 2025 and 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2025 AND customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2026)

question: Which month of 2025 had the highest revenue? Show the month number and the revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) AS month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2025 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

question: What percentage of total revenue does each category contribute? Show category and percentage rounded to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) / SUM(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price)) OVER (), 2) AS pct FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.category

question: On average, how many days pass between a customer's signup date and their first order? Consider only customers who have ordered. Round to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(d), 2) FROM (SELECT MIN(o.order_date) - c.signup_date AS d FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.signup_date) t

question: Among customers who have spent money, how many have a total spend above the average total spend per customer?
gold_sql: WITH s AS (SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS t FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s WHERE t > (SELECT AVG(t) FROM s)

question: How many orders were placed on a weekend (Saturday or Sunday) in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2025 AND EXTRACT(DOW FROM order_date) IN (0, 6)

question: What is the total quantity sold in each category during 2025? Show category and quantity.
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2025 GROUP BY p.category

question: How many customers have a total spend greater than 50000?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT o.customer_id FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.customer_id HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) > 50000) t

question: totl revenue from orders paid by UPI?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.payment_method = 'UPI'

question: How many customers placed exactly one order?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 1) t

question: What is the average number of different products per order, rounded to 2 decimals?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(n), 2) FROM (SELECT order_id, COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS n FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) t

question: How many orders were placed by customers from the city of Delhi in 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.city = 'Delhi' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2026

question: List the 3 cheapest products in each category. Show category and product name.
gold_sql: SELECT category, product_name FROM (SELECT category, product_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY unit_price) AS rn FROM products) t WHERE rn <= 3

question: Ignoring the year, which month number has the most orders placed? Show the month number and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many customers have ordered products from at least 3 different categories?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT o.customer_id FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY o.customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) >= 3) t

question: whats the biggest single order by value? just the order id and its total
gold_sql: SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.order_id ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1

question: Compare 2025 and 2026: how many orders were placed in each year? Show year and count.
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) AS year, COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) IN (2025, 2026) GROUP BY 1

question: Among customers who signed up in 2025, what percentage placed at least one order? Round to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id), 2) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.signup_date) = 2025
